The final low incline dumbbell bench of the cycle. Reps are at their lowest this week, so this should be your heaviest dumbbell pressing of the block. The slight incline keeps the work on the upper chest while the dumbbells stay easy on the shoulders. Aim to beat Week 4 across all working sets.
"}]
